title: Schema-UI Host Bootstrap Document
description: B0 structural contract for the optional host bootstrap document (ADR-0035, spec 10 §2). Semantic rules (B1): version/capability negotiation per ADR-0009, availability gates, auth normalization, manifest capability narrowing and stable bootstrap results.

bootstrapVersion.description: Independent document version; first version is exactly 1.0 and must not be mixed with page/manifest versions.

requiredCapabilities.description: All elements participate in negotiation (ADR-0009). First version must include host.bootstrap (B1).

url.description: Relative API path (^/(?!/)[^\s\\]*$) or safe https: URL. Cross-API-baseURL-origin URLs must also declare sha256 (B1).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw 200 manifest response bytes, lowercase hex, exact compare.

messageKey.description: Optional display key; Host dictionary miss must fall back to its own safe generic copy, never echo server text.

retryAfterSeconds.description: Only allowed with mode maintenance; absent means manual retry only.

minimumHostVersion.description: Only allowed with mode upgrade-required; opaque display/diagnostic string, no SemVer guessing.

disabledCapabilities.description: Only allowed with mode degraded; registered capability IDs only (B1 checks against capability-registry.json).

CapabilityId.description: v2.8 起 ID 段内允许连字符（ADR-0034 机读语法增宽，容纳 host.failure-recovery）。
